name: sound-cue-toggle
title: Sound Cue Toggle
description: The switch for a room's sound cues, and the words for them. Sound is off until a person turns it on (a browser keeps a page silent until a tap, and a hall should not start making noise on its own). Every cue that plays is also written as a plain phrase…
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/sound-cue-toggle

Installed to `components/ui/games/sound-cue-toggle.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/games/sound-cue-toggle';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/sound-cue-toggle

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
